name.la: De exterminatione mali et promotione boni
name.en-US: On the Extermination of Evil and the Promotion of Good
name.pt-BR: Sobre a extinção do mal e a promoção do bem

description.la: De exterminatione mali et promotione boni, tractatus de confessione criminis et laudis.
description.en-US: Richard’s treatise on the confession of sin and the confession of praise, and the two promotions of virtue that follow. Latin only, from the Migne text (Patrologia Latina 196, 1855), a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: O tratado de Ricardo sobre a confissão do pecado e a confissão de louvor.

sources.edition: Migne, Patrologia Latina 196 (Paris 1855); TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), text RiSVi.DeExMaE, from the machine-corrected OCR of the Open Greek and Latin project.
sources.description: The complete PL text with its chapter divisions. PL page breaks and column numbers are dropped, and the PL tables of chapters (which repeat the chapter headings) are not imported. The OCR carries a few residual slips.
sources.tierEvidence: Migne’s Patrologia Latina (1854–1855) prints the medieval text; public domain everywhere.
